$comment: Local LLM served by llama.cpp or any OpenAI-compatible server.
There is no subscription, no quota window and no cache TTL to manage. The server runs on
the operator's own hardware; the only cost is electricity and VRAM, neither of which this
tool can meter. So every token price is null, every cache field is inert, and the scheduler
treats this worker as always-eligible from a quota perspective.
The models array is a default for Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B via llama.cpp. At commissioning the
adapter queries /v1/models and the user picks from whatever the server reports; models not
listed here get the fallback context window (32768).

cache.$comment: llama.cpp's --cache-reuse is server-side and automatic; no client lever exists.

compaction.$comment: No compaction mechanism. The bridge starts a fresh conversation each dispatch.

$plans_comment: No subscription, so no money to divide. `priced: false` is the whole answer and every run on
this cost model renders `n/a` rather than $0.00 - electricity is a real cost this tool cannot

quota.$comment: Local inference has no subscription quota. The worker is always eligible.
